data.name: Project Turbo Combat
data.detailed_description:
Weaponized Racing

Project Turbo Combat is a high-octane combat racing game where every lap is a firefight. Grab power-ups mid-race to launch homing missiles, spray oil slicks and slip spills, trigger nitro boosts, and blast rivals off the road as you fight your way to the front of the pack.

A Garage Built for War

From roaring classic muscle cars to razor-sharp modern sports sedans and electric hypercars, arm up a collection that fits your style and turn every race into a battle.

Race Solo or With Friends

Take on a full singleplayer campaign racing against AI-controlled bots, or go head-to-head with friends in multiplayer combat races.

Key Features
  • Weaponized Combat Racing - Fire homing missiles, drop oil slicks and slip spills, and unleash power-ups to wreck the competition.
  • Every Car Is a Weapon - Grab pickups mid-race and time your attacks and defenses to break away from the pack.
  • Singleplayer vs. Bots - Race a full campaign against AI-controlled bots.
  • Multiplayer Combat Racing - Battle friends and rivals online in the same weaponized race format.
  • Living Open World - Race through bustling streets, grand monuments, and glittering city locales.
  • Cockpit & Chase Cameras - Switch between an immersive interior view and a cinematic chase cam.
  • Grow Your Garage - Collect and drive a mix of muscle cars, modern sports cars, and EVs.

Race dirty. Weaponize your ride. Take the lead by any means necessary.

data.short_description: Project Turbo Combat is an explosive vehicular combat racer with singleplayer and multiplayer modes. Blast through a vivid open world in muscle cars, sports sedans and EVs, firing homing missiles, dropping oil slicks, and grabbing power-ups to wreck rivals and take the lead.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1909 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Requires a GPU supporting Shader Model 5.0 / compute shaders.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 6600 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD required for best performance at High Fidelity quality settings.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 13.0 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 (Apple Silicon required - Intel Macs not supported)
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated GPU (8-core) with Metal support
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio
  • Additional Notes: Apple Silicon (M1 or later) required. Intel-based Macs are not supported.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 14.0 Sonoma or later
  • Processor: Apple M3 or later
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M3 integrated GPU (10-core) or better
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
